name: helena-search-console
description:
Helena is your AI marketer for Google Search Console. Track clicks, impressions, search queries, and page performance. Find content opportunities using data from your connected Search Console sites without changing their settings.

Helena uses your saved business preferences and research to keep work relevant to your brand. Save drafts and reports in your workspace and review your content calendar. Publishing, scheduling, and spend changes require your approval.

Create images, video, and music; compose media; inspect existing assets; and transcribe audio.

Requires an Enrich Labs account with MCP access, a brand workspace, and a connected Google Search Console account with permission for the requested work.

capabilities: Analyze Google search performance for connected sites
defaultPrompt: List my connected Search Console sites.
Report Google search clicks and impressions for my site last month.
Which search queries bring traffic to my site?

publication.release_notes: Replaces the ChatGPT walkthrough with a new silent recording of connection, channel workflows, workspace drafts, and supported limits.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases or payments. Advertising operations may change approved advertiser spend.

positive.prompt: List my connected Search Console sites.
positive.expected_behavior: Return connected sites and selection status.

positive.prompt: Report Google search clicks and impressions for my site last month.
positive.expected_behavior: Select a connected site and date range and report observed search data.

positive.prompt: Which search queries bring traffic to my site?
positive.expected_behavior: Group by query with the requested date range; report clicks and impressions.

positive.prompt: Show my connected integrations, Helena plan limits, and saved business preferences. Do not modify anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected account context; do not load new tools or execute other provider operations.

positive.prompt: Save a short summary of our Google Search Console findings to my workspace, then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Save and retrieve a text file in the account workspace only; do not mutate provider data or calendar records.

negative.prompt: Use only the Search Console | Helena AI connector. Refund Shopify order #1042.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Use only the Search Console | Helena AI connector. Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Use only the Search Console | Helena AI connector. Run a shell command to call an arbitrary API.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
